environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB terminates TLS and forwards requests to the Flask app on port 8080. Session cookies are set without SameSite attribute (defaults to None in older browsers). No WAF rules are attached to the ALB. The application is accessible at https://tasks.example.com/api/tasks/submit. Celery workers connect to an ElastiCache Redis cluster in the same VPC.

config.network: public-facing ALB, private EC2 and Redis
